dialogue.user: Those are some interesting options! I'm particularly interested in the **Women's Slip On Flat Shoes with Ultra Flexible Sole and Elastic Grip Upper** because of the price and the good rating. Could you tell me more about the materials used in these shoes?
dialogue.agent:
The **Women's Slip On Flat Shoes with Ultra Flexible Sole and Elastic Grip Upper** have the following features:

- Rubber sole
- Ultra Lightweight with Flexible Sliced Sole and Microfiber fabric upper
- Plush insole with Extra heel support and Vulcanized Midsole
- Breathable engineered vegan-friendly upper available in perforated and faux suede
- Run true to normal size
- Double gore elastic foot overlay for maximum flexibility and fit

These shoes are designed to be lightweight, comfortable, and stylish, with a focus on providing good support and flexibility.

result.title: Women's Slip On Flat Shoes with Ultra Flexible Sole and Elastic Grip Upper
result.features:
Rubber sole
Ultra Lightweight with Flexible Sliced Sole and Microfiber fabric upper - Lightweight feels so much better on the knees and hips! Airy, roomy and featherweight, the Fresh is ready for whatever your long day has in store!
 Plush insole with Extra heel support and Vulcanized Midsole - A bit more supportive in the heel with flexibility and oomph in the arch and midfoot gives your feet the correct walking gait and support you need
 Breathable engineered vegan friendly upper - Available in perforated and faux suede, the Fresh upper is both lightweight and very stylish. All vegan materials, the upper is thin and flexible to fit and stretch after a couple of wearings to your foot's design and shape
 Run true to normal size - Most customers have expressed that these run pretty true to their normal flat or sandal sizing with a loose, roomy fit in the heel area
 Double gore elastic foot overlay for maximum flexibility and fit - Details matter, so we added a double gore stretch inlay over the top of the upper/foot. These allow a bit more stretch for easy off and on and give a bit more as you step for comfort.
